description: Gold question set for the Indus Air RAG knowledge assistant. Questions were written from the contact-centre agent's point of view before the retriever was tuned, using passenger phrasing rather than the wording used in the policy documents. Out-of-scope cases test the similarity floor: the assistant is expected to refuse them, not to answer from the closest loosely related section.
author: Muhammad Faozan Mujtaba

cases.question: How much hand luggage can I take on board?
cases.notes: Passenger says 'hand luggage'; the policy says 'cabin baggage'.

cases.question: What is the checked baggage allowance on an Indus Flex ticket to Dubai?
cases.notes: Needs the international column of the fare family table.

cases.notes: Airline-flavoured vocabulary but no policy grants this. Must refuse rather than improvise from the fare family table.

cases.notes: Catering is not in the library. Must refuse.
